name: Estival-Fjard
description: Dust finer than flour pools in the low places, swallowing craters to their rims. Nothing has disturbed impact-scarred wastelands in a million years, and the dust keeps its surface smooth as held breath.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
Regular pulses leave the derelict space station in orbit aimed at deep space, toward nothing catalogued. The pattern has repeated unchanged for the nine years anyone has listened.
The artifact market prices fragments from this world like scripture. Provenance papers are forged in three systems, badly.
